{{Top|leg}}
'''Data-filaments''' were a type of data transfer technology. Protected data-filaments connected [[TT-40 librarian droid]]s to the central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] mainframe from which they drew their information.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
